=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12, 15, 187 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode cleanup is deferred until Step 1 reads the plan, but Step 1 has no operational instruction to invoke it, while the cleanup-section header directs every stage to run it in Step 0.
  WHY: Without an operational trigger after the `Source issue:` identifier is available, an unattended `/reclarify` resume may leave the stopped stage session unarchived. The core timing issue was rated BLOCKER; the contradictory-header aspect was rated MAJOR.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12, 15, 187 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode cleanup is deferred until Step 1 reads the plan, but Step 1 has no operational instruction to invoke it, while the cleanup-section header directs every stage to run it in Step 0.
  WHY: Without an operational trigger after the `Source issue:` identifier is available, an unattended `/reclarify` resume may leave the stopped stage session unarchived. The core timing issue was rated BLOCKER; the contradictory-header aspect was rated MAJOR.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:108, 191 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The stop and cleanup sequences lack robust failure-handling paths for transient errors in `set_session_title` or `mcp__github__issue_read`.
  WHY: A rename failure can leave the session with its old title, and a label-read failure can skip archival without reporting, requiring manual operator intervention. z-ai_glm-5_2 reports that the rename and label-read failure paths are already addressed.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12, 191 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A project-mode resume without a `Source issue:` header skips cleanup without logging that it was skipped.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish an intentional skip from cleanup that never ran or failed to trigger, making the operator-visible report indistinguishable from a project-mode resume that has no zombie checkers either.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:190, 260 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup predicate relies on a title suffix that is not contractually pinned as unique, and the test only checks that the phrase doesn't appear elsewhere in the text, not that no slug or stage name could produce a matching title.
  WHY: A future edit could introduce a project slug or stage name containing "blocked on issue", causing the cleanup to select and potentially archive the wrong session. The slug derivation rules (lowercase ASCII and hyphens from the plan filename) make this unlikely but not impossible.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and byte-identical twin workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md): line 12 (new Step 0 child bullet "Issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block"), line 15 (Step 1 "Resolve the plan doc."), line 187 (Zombie-checker cleanup section header) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The new Step 0 bullet at line 12 instructs the session to run the Zombie-checker cleanup "once step 1 has read the plan", but Step 1 (line 15) has no operational instruction to invoke it, and the cleanup-section header at line 187 still reads "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up:" — the header is unchanged and contradicts the deferred issue-mode timing.
  WHY: An unattended session walking the Step 0 bullets sees the issue-mode resume bullet, then reads the cleanup-section header at line 187 which directs cleanup into Step 0. The session either (a) attempts cleanup in Step 0 without the `Source issue:` identifier (the plan hasn't been read yet, so the label-check predicate "no longer carries `ai:claude-blocked`" can never resolve and silently falls through), or (b) defers the cleanup per the bullet text but never returns to run it because Step 1 does not say to. In both cases the stopped `… — blocked on issue` session stays in the session list until a human archives it by hand — exactly the bug the PR is meant to fix. Cause 2 in the PR description ("The Zombie-checker cleanup ran only from inside resume hygiene, so it never ran on this path") is therefore not addressed: the new Step 0 child bullet is a textual deferral with no operational hook.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "The Zombie-checker cleanup ran only from inside resume hygiene, so it never ran on this path." (PR description cause 2; restated by changelog "That cleanup now also runs on an issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block"). The fix's contract is that the cleanup actually fires on a `/reclarify` resume, after Step 1 reads the plan and the `Source issue:` identifier is available.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and byte-identical twin) Step 1 (after the existing "Read" in full) — explicit instruction to run the Zombie-checker cleanup when the plan header carries a `Source issue:` line; OR the cleanup-section header at line 187 must explicitly carve out issue-mode timing. Today, neither exists: Step 1 (line 15) ends with "Read it in full" without invoking the cleanup, and the cleanup-section header at line 187 still says "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene".
  Evidence of absence: The diff adds only the Step 0 child bullet at line 12 and a new "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions." sub-bullet inside the cleanup section at line 190. No diff hunk places the trigger inside Step 1; no diff hunk revises line 187; the cleanup-section header still reads "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up".
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 187 (and byte-identical twin line 187).

The header still contradicts the new Step 0 bullet's deferral.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
